pages.title: Crushed Ceramic
pages.text: A Mortar and Pestle turns one fired Brick into one Grog. Later the Quern yields two Grog per Brick. Grog is fired ceramic powder, not raw clay.

pages.title: Mix and Shape
pages.text: Two Clay Balls and one Grog make two Refractory Clay. Use a Brick Mold for refractory bricks and a Pottery Wheel for crucibles, tuyères, and casting molds. Fire every unfired part in a normal furnace.

pages.title: Furnace Construction
pages.text: Refractory Bricks, a fired Crucible, and a fired Tuyere build the Crucible Furnace. A fired Casting Mold is loaded separately as a reusable catalyst. Prepare all parts before attempting raw-copper casting.
